senses.caution: It tells people the thing is temporary, and they will later ask when it is being removed. For a rough first version of the real work, say draft instead.
senses.definition: A temporary support that is removed once the real system works on its own.

senses.gloss: a setup for testing a system
gloss_distractors: a contract with an outside vendor
senses.caution: In AI work people usually hear evaluation harness, so say so if you mean a general test setup. Use it for tools you built yourself, and not for a public benchmark you only ran.
senses.definition: A setup built to run a system automatically and check how it behaves.

senses.caution: It promises that nothing real can be affected, and compliance teams will hold you to that. It says nothing about how realistic the setup is.
senses.definition: An isolated place to run something where it cannot affect anything real.
